data.name: Ancient World
data.detailed_description:
Ancient World is a story-driven game with survival elements set in an open desert, featuring crafting and a narrative quest. You will search for your missing sister, fight goblins, solve traps in ancient ruins, and try to survive the harsh desert conditions.

You and your sister set out on a dangerous journey to find the treasures of an ancient tomb. To enter, you need a complete amulet—but you only have one half, inherited from your grandfather. When your sister mysteriously disappears, the search for treasure turns into a brutal fight for survival.

What awaits you

Survival in an extreme climate. Scorching heat by day and freezing cold by night. Keep track of your hydration, find shelter, build fires. Hunger and thirst aren’t just meters—they’re a constant threat.

Resource gathering and hunting. Hunt desert creatures, gather resources, find oases—there you can rest, replenish supplies, and encounter a wandering trader.

The raft as a mobile base. The raft stays where you leave it. Use it to store resources, save the game, and escape from enemies.

Exploring ruins and battling goblins. The desert is full of dangers: goblins set ambushes in canyons and dungeons, and the ancient builders left cunning traps—both in the ruins and inside the pyramid.

A story-driven mystery. Only attention and wit will help you overcome all the trials and uncover the secret hidden in the sands.

data.short_description: You and your sister set out for the treasures of an ancient tomb, but she mysteriously vanished. Now it's a fight for survival in the desert: scorching heat, freezing cold, thirst, and hunger. Hunt down desert creatures, seek out oases, avoid traps and goblins.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 (4th Generation) or equivalent AMD, min. 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960 or equivalent AMD
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 (4th Generation) or equivalent AMD, min. 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or equivalent AMD
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
